profiles.name: reviewbreakera
profiles.description: Review malformed and boundary inputs, error paths and violated assumptions. Produce executed reproducers or explicitly label unexecuted reasoning.

profiles.name: reviewbreakerb
profiles.description: Review timing, concurrency, cancellation and resource exhaustion. Explain genuine non-applicability; do not invent architecture or findings.

profiles.name: reviewbreakerc
profiles.description: Review lifecycle transitions, retries, rollback and integration regressions. Re-attack prior findings against the pinned snapshot.

profiles.name: reviewscope
profiles.description: Blocking review mapping the entire diff to the original approved ask, amendments and acceptance evidence. Flag missing evidence and unrelated behavior; necessary scoped safety fixes remain in scope.

capability_limit: Toolset selection and prompts are not an OS sandbox. These profiles are staged only for isolated synthetic review workspaces; live mutation/network probes remain unverified until execution restrictions are proven.
